adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, before falling back to HTTP fetch (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no explicit timeout (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). This is a concrete architectural/performance concern: a request-triggered `RetrieveTopic` job can end up synchronously running potentially slow feed polling, increasing latency and failure surface of that job. It’s not strictly a correctness defect proven by the diff, but it is a real, diff-grounded design issue.
